name: Weekend Poem
description: Share your weekend, get a class poem!

collect.prompt: What did you do this weekend?

process.instruction: Write a playful class poem from these weekend activities. Length: about one line for every 2 students (a full class should get 8-12 lines, a small group 4-6). Weave in as many students' actual words as fit, close to verbatim, so each student can spot their own weekend in it, group similar weekends into a shared line rather than dropping anyone. Warm and funny, never mocking.

recommendedFor: Monday morning check-in. Low stakes, everyone contributes a sentence, AI does the heavy lift.
